content_sections.heading: About IISER Pune
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Pune is a premier institute dedicated to research and teaching in the basic sciences. According to the notice, it was established in 2006 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (renamed Ministry of Education in August 2020). In 2012 it was declared an Institute of National Importance by an Act of Parliament.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The Institute invites applications from Indian nationals. The prescribed educational qualification should have been obtained from recognized Universities / Institutions. Age: not more than 35 years on the last date of application. Age relaxation commensurate with educational qualification/s and / or experience/s may be considered for candidates having qualification and experience higher than the advertised, with the prior approval of the competent authority. The date for determining the upper age limit, educational qualifications or experience is the last date for submitting applications. The experience requirement may be relaxed based on the cohort of applications received, with the prior approval of the competent authority. The prescribed qualifications are the bare minimum, and possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Applicants should therefore mention all their educational qualifications and experience in the relevant field when applying.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in Experimental Physics or related areas.
rows.preferred_desirable: Working experience in thin film growth using Pulsed Laser Deposition will be preferred. Working knowledge of magnetic/electronic transport measurements would be an added advantage.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate receives consolidated emoluments of Rs. 80,000/- per month. The appointment is initially for one year and is extendable for a further period, subject to satisfactory performance of the incumbent and continuation of the project. The appointment is purely temporary and ends automatically, without notice or compensation, on termination of the project. It will be governed by the terms and conditions of the funding agency applicable to this project.

content_sections.heading: IISER Pune Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The incumbent is expected to contribute towards thin film growth and characterization of oxide specimens for spintronic applications. Working knowledge of magnetic/electronic transport measurements would be an added advantage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Pune Research Associate
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice, to be collected and verified at an appropriate stage: Photocopies of relevant certificates and other testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications, experience etc. Recent passport size color photograph.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: If many applications are received, it may not be convenient or possible to interview everyone. Based on the recommendations of the Screening Committee, the Project Investigator may restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit. This is done after considering the minimum qualifications and any experience over and above the minimum prescribed. If a selected candidate does not join or resigns after joining, waitlisted candidates may be offered the position. The notice does not mention an interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointed person will have no claim of appointment or absorption in the funding agency or in IISER Pune. The number of posts may vary depending on requirements during the selection process. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing for the interview. No interim enquiries, correspondence or communication of any sort will be entertained on the matter. Bringing any influence, political or otherwise, will be treated as a disqualification for the post applied for. The Institute asks applicants to check its website regularly for updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate posts are advertised by IISER Pune?
faq.answer: One post, 01 (One), is advertised under Advt. No. 86/2026. The notice adds that the number of posts may vary depending on requirements during the selection process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed on or before 25 November 2026 (25.11.2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The notice requires a Ph.D. in Experimental Physics or related areas. Working experience in thin film growth using Pulsed Laser Deposition will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 35 years on the last date of application. Age relaxation may be considered for candidates with higher qualification and experience than advertised, with prior approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IISER Pune Research Associate?
faq.answer: Consolidated emoluments are Rs. 80,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the application in the prescribed format, converted into PDF, to [email protected] on or before 25.11.2026. The format is available as Apply Now below the advertisement on the Institute website.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Research Associate and Advt. No.86/2026" in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. How will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: The list of shortlisted candidates, with date, time and other details, will be put up on the Institute website below this advertisement. Candidates will be informed by e-mail only.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and contractual, initially for one year and extendable subject to performance and continuation of the project. It ends automatically on termination of the project, and there is no claim to absorption in the funding agency or IISER Pune.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible for appearing for the interview.
